entry.title: TikTok Farlands — Urban Dictionary
entry.content: TikTok Farlands is a term to refer to videos that you see after scrolling for a long time. These videos can potentially be disturbing, or weird. Said videos can also have low likes, or low comments. Example: “I reached the TikTok Farlands bro”

entry.title: chud run — Urban Dictionary
entry.content: A trip to a grocery store, convenience store, or gas station for the sole purpose of buying an excessive amount of junk food and sugary drinks, usually with friends. A chud run often happens late at night and ends with everyone involved hating themselves afterwards. Example: "Hey bro you tryna go on a chud run with me??"

entry.title: Glippy — Urban Dictionary
entry.content:
A slang term for GLP-1 medications(like Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, etc.), usually referring to their appetite-killing, weight-loss, or “I forgot to eat” effects rather than the medical details.
Usage: * Often casual, ironic, or meme-y * Can imply effortless weight loss, suppressed hunger, or being “powered by pharmaceuticals”
Notes: Not a brand name—just shorthand for the whole GLP-1 wave. Frequently shows up in online jokes, gym talk, and group chats where people pretend they’re *totally*

entry.content: The phenomenon where adults salivate at children's toys Example: Every time I walk into the toy aisle, I catch myself kidulting over the latest action figures and LEGO sets!

entry.content: The feeling and build up in your mouth/throat of saliva that sometimes accompanies nausea. Example: Oh man those burritos gave me the throat sweats, I hope I don’t have food poisoning.

entry.content: A guy who thinks he's a country kinda guy, but in reality lives a comfortable city / suburban life. Example: Eugene: Look at that dude in the cowboy hat! Todd: He's just a concrete cowboy.

entry.content: The recent boom in consumer spending on entertainment and experiences with a high demand running up the cost of enjoying of those experiences. Example: I’m trying to go to this Taylor Swift concert but the funflation has made it so impossible for me to afford tickets.

entry.title: Boffin — Urban Dictionary
entry.content:
British slang for a scientist or technical expert, esp . when the speaker is not certain of the expert’s specific field of study. Not necessarily derogatory, but typically used by persons without a technical background. In the US, the equivalent would be “egghead”, “squint”, or “geek.”

entry.title: Eternity leave — Urban Dictionary
entry.content:
When some resigns or retires from a job, they are on "eternity leave". This can also refer to someone who has passed away, especially someone who worked somewhere for a long time, retired/resigned, then passed away later. Example: Oh I'm sorry, you didn't know that Kelly is on eternity leave? She resigned and moved to Hawaii!
With regrets I would like to inform you that my boss is officially on eternity leave. I will never see or hear them again. Ever.
entry.dc:creator: Urban Dictionary

entry.title: Utility beer — Urban Dictionary
entry.content: Utility beer is the beer you keep around for the day-to-day moments when beer is a necessity to assist in pedestrian activities (golf, plumbing, yardwork, babysitting, staff meetings, Zoom calls). For the beer snob it is the beer you save for neighbors when they drop in at 3 p.m. on a Tuesday. It is differentiated from the actual high-end beer you save for special events, holidays, and special tastings.
